data.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiencies
data.description: A cabalist is not proficient with medium armor. Like a magus, he can cast cabalist spells while wearing light armor without incurring the normal arcane spell failure chance. This alters the vigilante's armor and weapon proficiencies.
